Where it started

This is what a client looked like before.

Graphics and phone photos mixed together. No consistent look. No character. No world.

No systemPosts made one at a time, with nothing tying them together.
No identityA real person, but nothing designed around him to remember.
No motionStill images only, with no story to move through.
Step one

A real person becomes a character.

Designed once, approved by the client, then locked. The same man, from every angle, in every scene.

Step two

Then we build his world.

Six places that match six ideas he teaches. Drawn in one flat, consistent style.

Step three

Then we place him in it.

Same character, same place, two ways to tell it. The client picks.

The result

And it lands in the feed.

Approved posts, built on the same system.

Motion

Then it moves.

Short films, packaging and animation, made for the same character and world.

What this means

A studio that places people.

Client placementA character and a world built around who they are.
AnimationShort animated pieces from the approved world.
Content systemPosts, carousels and captions on a steady rhythm.
Film and videoWhere it started, and still how we capture the real person.

Every step is approved by the client before the next one starts.

Placing people where their story lives.
